10.t: Working with data: living lunch results
q: Which wrapping had the most mould on day 8?
On which day did mould first appear?
Describe and compare the results for the plastic bag and the paper bag.
Both start growing after day 2, but the plastic bag grows much faster: 80% compared with 30% by day 8.
Suggest why the paper bag had least mould, and one control variable that must be kept the same for a fair test.
Paper lets water evaporate, so the bread dries out and mould grows slowly; a sealed plastic bag keeps it damp. Controls: same type and size of bread, same water, same temperature and place.
